$schema: lane CONTEXT-INTL full-bake plan, 2026-09-03 — data for the orchestrator's deliberate operational bakes. NOT a workflow file. Sibling of regions-full-bake-plan.json (EU).

calibration.tiles_weight_model: tiles_gb = pbf_gb x [0.8 .. 1.9] on a WHOLE-STATE row (7 layers, lean upper) — inherited from the EU plan. US + AE rows are METRO clips: they DOWNLOAD a state/gcc extract but TILE only a metro bbox, so their tile output is small regardless of the download size.
calibration.time_model: PROJECTED (EU plan model): ~15-25 min/GB of TILED pbf + ~2-4 min fixed per row (download+clip). A metro clip tiles in ~1-3 min; its cost is the state-extract download. The `act` whole-state row (18.9 MB) is the AU calibration pilot, as luxembourg/estonia were for the EU.
calibration.buildings_local_bake: IMPOSSIBLE on this box (osmium/tippecanoe/duckdb/docker all absent 2026-09-03). Proof ran at the pipeline's plan/dry-run/preflight layer (lane doc §2-3). The AE rows additionally need DuckDB (Overture) — the §BAKE-OVERTURE gate fails loud if absent.

prerequisites_before_any_publish: R2 budget + workflow-switch prerequisite STILL BINDS (EU plan). ALL_REGIONS is now 49 rows; an unscoped full bake cannot finish. context-bake.yml must go per-region + merged-artifact / incremental `aws s3 sync` (bake.mjs:57; --regions-json + merge-tiles.mjs are the machine-readable half). Until then a region-scoped publish REPLACES the whole tileset (§BAKE-BY-REGION).
AE rows require DuckDB (local `duckdb` or the tools/context-bake Docker image) for the Overture buildings read — same gate as riyadh/jeddah.
NT scope check: `northernterritory` is included on the Saudi precedent (geo-fenced parcels != no context row). Drop it if the founder's '6 states + ACT' scope is strict.

Overture density calibration: a Dubai/AbuDhabi-specific OSM-vs-Overture count probe (Riyadh rule) is owed; the flip is founder-directed + riyadh/jeddah-precedented, so it bakes now and the probe refines maxzoom.
